title: Paws on the Sand: Lionessy Sins
summary: Party-based RPG-platformer featuring hand-drawn 2D graphics. The action unfolds in an ancient world inspired by Sumer-Akkadian, Egyptian, and ancient Slavic mythology. This realm is brimming with city-states, pagan deities, and eerie dungeons. Humans are absent from the game, only anthro-animals!
about:
«Paws on the Sand: Lionessy Sins» is a party-based RPG-platformer with hand-drawn 2D graphics. The game is set in an ancient world inspired by Sumer-Akkadian, Egyptian, and ancient Slavic mythology. This world is full of rival city-states, ancient pagan goddesses, dark gloomy dungeons and bizarre monsters. There are no humans in the game, instead characters are represented as different types of anthropomorphic animals.

PLAY FOR THE LIONESSY - THE DEFENDER OF URUK

The main lionessy character, a resident of the captured ancient city-state of Uruk, must free her folk from slavery. She will also need to rescue her lover from the ruthless grasp of the underworld goddess Ereshkigal, who is in eternal conflict with her sister, the goddess of fertility, Ishtar. Along the way, the lionessy will visit neighboring city-states, explore far lands and undertake (or not) numerous side-quests.


«Paws on the Sand: Lionessy Sins» enhances the mechanics of the 2D slasher with a distinctive combat system designed for a party of four characters. The game seamlessly merges 2D platformer gameplay with the intricate elements of a party-based RPG, including item enchantment, skill/class enhancement, and role distribution within the party. And, of course, the inclusion of dark magic!



• Unique combat system for a party of four characters, managed simultaneously as a whole.
• RPG-component with rich customization of equipment, the choice of suitable classes for team members and 16 playable species.
• An extensive and interconnected game world with densely populated city-states, gloomy dungeons and spacious levels. New abilities gained during the game allow you to get to previously inaccessible corners of the world!
• The plot and side quests of the game will not leave anyone indifferent.
• Embedded CCG (collectible card game) built into the main game will complement the main gameplay and allow you to relax between combat and exploration!
